First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: social; regroups at turns and hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @bicyclebutler the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Bicycle Butler Wednesday Ride group ride

A weekly shop ride led by Bicycle Butler's mechanics and friends. New riders welcome, all bike types including e-bikes. The route changes weekly and gets posted by noon on Wednesday. Runs year-round; lights required in fall and early spring. Helmets required.
